blocker.summary: r474 built a minimal, env-var-gated synthetic controller input mechanism (AC6_NATIVE_INPUT_AUTO_CONFIRM) in NativeGuestInputService::get_state()/is_connected() (native_guest_input.cpp, clean at HEAD before this cycle -- committed directly, not part of the entangled backlog), reusing the existing XamInputGetState injection point rather than building new infrastructure. It pulses the A button on a fixed 60Hz duty cycle so an unknown confirmation screen gets a chance to advance. Verified: native ctest 11/11, default behavior unchanged when the env var is unset. Re-ran the probe with the synthetic input AND a probe window raised to 90s (3.6x the prior 25s cap): the result was IDENTICAL to before (86 draws, non_black=0) -- no effect at all. The log shows a silent plateau after the initial 86 draws, unlike the oracle side which kept actively rendering/presenting for its full 573s while waiting for the correct confirmation. This weakens r473's working hypothesis ('just missing a confirmation like the oracle side') -- the native stall looks more like a native-specific content/loading block than a missing input. Named for r475: investigate precisely what the 86 draws represent and why nothing happens afterward (native loading/threading trace), not another input attempt. The 320-entry pinned shader registry (r472) remains correctly installed; this finding doesn't invalidate it, it just means nothing yet exercises the new coverage.
